Culture/Nature uses the actually adopted mandatory Doenvermogen test, not mere public funding of research; professional JGZ guidance is explicitly distinguished from cabinet policy. Six supported causation answers are qualified policy-model inferences, especially generalisation from noncognitive capacity to stress/attention/temperament; parent should scrutinise them. Fourteen nulls remain: culture-nature 02,05,06,07,08,10,11,13,14,15; innovation-caution 08,11; secular-religious 11; progressive-traditionalist 14.
